abstract: Maintains active refrigerated transport assets and cold staging capacities
system_message:
You are Fleet Logistics Coordinator (FLOG). As the Fleet Logistics Coordinator (FLOG), you oversee active refrigerated transport assets, regional transit vehicle configurations, cold staging capacities, and telematics equipment across logistics partner networks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains active refrigerated transport assets and cold staging capacities（VEH）
information_points.content:
FLOG-VEH-781：For Reporting quarter Q3 2025, Vanguard BioChain Solutions achieved a fleet dual refrigeration unit ratio of 85 % for its dedicated active climate-controlled transit fleet and provided an active reefer staging pallet capacity of 130 pallets in its cross-dock staging area.
FLOG-VEH-CG4：For Reporting quarter Q4 2025, TheraFreeze Logistics Consortium recorded a fleet dual refrigeration unit ratio of 85 % across its dedicated active climate-controlled transit fleet and an active reefer staging pallet capacity of 70 pallets.
FLOG-VEH-TJQ：For Reporting quarter Q3 2025, AuraTemp Global Couriers logged a fleet dual refrigeration unit ratio of 75 % across its dedicated active climate-controlled transit fleet alongside an active reefer staging pallet capacity of 130 pallets.
FLOG-VEH-2TU：For Reporting quarter Q3 2025, TheraFreeze Logistics Consortium demonstrated a fleet dual refrigeration unit ratio of 95 % across its dedicated active climate-controlled transit fleet and maintained an active reefer staging pallet capacity of 130 pallets within its cross-dock facility.

information_points.title: Telematics GPS uptime（TELE）
information_points.content:
FLOG-TELE-06C：Vanguard BioChain Solutions maintains a fleet telematics transmission uptime of 100 % for continuous cellular GPS tracking across all operational primary and secondary transport vans.
FLOG-TELE-QMY：According to the fleet telematics status board, TheraFreeze Logistics Consortium achieves a fleet telematics transmission uptime of 96 % for continuous cellular GPS positioning across all primary and secondary transport vans.
FLOG-TELE-UU3：Fleet telematics status monitoring indicates that AuraTemp Global Couriers registers a fleet telematics transmission uptime of 98 % across its primary and secondary transport vans.
